features.title: A nine-hour IBM Community meetup held inside a 3D world
features.summary: three.ws runs the Three.ws User Group on IBM Community, a public group for developers building AI agents with 3D capabilities. Its first meetup ran nine hours, held entirely inside a persistent three.ws 3D world rather than on a call. The world was open to anyone with the link and peaked at 3,145 concurrent avatars. The agenda was a live tour of the platform from inside the world, community demos and open Q&A, and attendees received a permanent in-world Meetup Laurel. It was organized with the group's organizer on IBM's side.
